import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date to datetime for time series analysis
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive analysis
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# 1. Total Sales by Product (Top Left)
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors = sns.color_palette('viridis', len(product_sales))
axes[0, 0].barh(product_sales.index, product_sales.values, color=colors)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=11)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
for i, v in enumerate(product_sales.values):
    axes[0, 0].text(v + 50, i, f'${v:,.0f}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Sales Distribution by Customer Age Group (Top Right)
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().reindex(age_order)
colors2 = sns.color_palette('coolwarm', len(age_sales))
wedges, texts, autotexts = axes[0, 1].pie(age_sales.values, labels=age_sales.index, 
                                           autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors2,
                                           explode=[0.02]*len(age_sales),
                                           shadow=True, startangle=90)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Sales Distribution by Customer Age Group', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_fontsize(10)
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 3. Average Transaction by Size and Product (Bottom Left)
pivot_data = df.pivot_table(values='total', index='product', columns='size', aggfunc='mean')
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
pivot_data = pivot_data.reindex(columns=[s for s in size_order if s in pivot_data.columns])
sns.heatmap(pivot_data, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='YlOrRd', ax=axes[1, 0],
            cbar_kws={'label': 'Average Total ($)'})
axes[1, 0].set_title('Average Transaction Value by Product & Size', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Size', fontsize=11)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=11)

# 4. Payment Method Distribution with Takeaway Breakdown (Bottom Right)
payment_takeaway = df.groupby(['payment_method', 'is_takeaway']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
payment_takeaway.columns = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
payment_takeaway.plot(kind='bar', ax=axes[1, 1], color=['#3498db', '#e74c3c'], edgecolor='black')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Orders by Payment Method & Service Type', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Payment Method', fontsize=11)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Number of Orders', fontsize=11)
axes[1, 1].legend(title='Service Type', fontsize=10)
axes[1, 1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)
for container in axes[1, 1].containers:
    axes[1, 1].bar_label(container, fontsize=9)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
